# maro env delete

Delete an OpenShift configmap or secret.

## Usage

```bash
maro env delete
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Alias    | Type | Description |
| -------- | -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| None     | del, rm  | None | None        |

## Notes

- Requires appropriate access to the OpenShift project.
- Lets you select whether to delete a configmap or a secret.
